description: This file defines the enum GatewayRemoteConfig that provides static methods for resolving and normalizing connection configuration details such as transport type, URL, token, and URL normalization for gateway remote configuration in a networked application.

classes.name: GatewayRemoteConfig
classes.description: A namespace enum containing static methods for resolving and normalizing remote gateway configuration parameters.

classes.name: TokenValue
classes.description: An enum representing different types of token values used in the remote configuration.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport type (direct or ssh) from a nested dictionary representing the configuration.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Resolves the token value from the configuration, returning an appropriate enum case.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Provides the token string if available and valid.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns a normalized URL object for the gateway URL.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into its normalized string form after validation.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a raw URL string into a URL object if it meets certain criteria, such as scheme and host validation.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Determines the default port for a given URL based on its scheme.
